settings.label: Tenant
settings.description: Microsoft-365-Tenant (GUID oder Domain), der in das OAuth-Token-URL-Template `https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/token` eingesetzt wird. Pro Quelle verschieden — daher Instanz-Scope.

settings.label: Site-URL
settings.description: URL der SharePoint-Site (z. B. https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/Finance), die der Connector über Microsoft Graph liest. Pro Quelle verschieden — daher Instanz-Scope.

settings.label: Client-Secret
settings.description: Client-Secret der Azure-AD-App-Registrierung für den client_credentials-Grant. Referenz auf einen Keychain-Eintrag (niemals inline); die OAuth-Injektion bleibt das `sharepoint`-auth_binding (D8).

auth_bindings.name: sharepoint
auth_bindings.description: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint OAuth access (host token injected as bearer). Hosts are omitted deliberately — they are tenant/site-specific and set by the operator at runtime (see config_keys tenant/site_url + system/oauth.yaml).
